function.name: musicCharts_getMostPlayed
function.description: This function retrieves the most played song in a particular genre from a specified region Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

genre.description: Music genre e.g., Rock, Pop, HipHop etc.

region.description: Region where the song popularity is to be checked

duration.description: Time duration in hours for which the music played count will be considered. default is 0

We need to use the function musicCharts_getMostPlayed. The function signature: genre, region, duration optional. We need to call twice: once for pop globally? The user didn't specify region for pop. Could assume worldwide or default region? The function requires region. We could set region to "worldwide" or "global". But maybe we should ask clarifying question? The user asked "目前最受歡迎的流行歌曲是什麼？" That implies current most popular pop song worldwide. So we can set region to "worldwide" or "global". The function might accept region string. Let's use "worldwide".

Second: "澳洲目前最受歡迎的搖滾歌曲" => region "Australia" or "Australia" region. So call with genre "Rock", region "Australia".
